youtube.title: Video from a chat with Claude in 3 steps: install, one MCP tool call, a seamless loop
youtube.description:
Video from a chat with Claude: 3 steps.
Install the funkbox plugin in Claude Code with one line, Claude calls one MCP tool (loop_render), and a loop comes back that passed funkbox's machine check for seamless looping. 51 MCP tools, all on your own computer.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
